instructions: This package is the CREED OS web application built with Svelte 5, SvelteKit 2, Tailwind CSS 4, and the WAY Design System. Enforce: 1) Svelte 5 runes ($props, $state, $derived, $effect) exclusively, 2) WAY Design System zero-radius tactile styling (strictly rounded-none, no rounded-md or rounded-lg), 3) Semantic OKLCH tokens only (no ad-hoc hex codes), 4) Strict 8pt spacing rhythm, 5) Full interactive state coverage.

rules.rule: Every Svelte component must use Svelte 5 runes. Do not use legacy Svelte 4 'export let' or reactive declarations '$:'. Use $props(), $state(), and $derived().

Enforce zero rounded corners across all components, containers, cards, dialogs, inputs, and buttons. Never use rounded-sm, rounded-md, rounded-lg, or rounded-full unless specifically rendering circular avatars. Use rounded-none.
Do not hardcode hex color values (e.g. #03080e, #38bdf8). Use semantic CSS variable tokens: var(--surface-canvas), var(--surface-raised), var(--text-primary), var(--accent-cyan), etc.
Never expose raw psychometric parameters (theta, SE, 3PL a/b/c, discrimination, information curves) to students or parents. Display growth-oriented narrative language instead.
All interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs) must implement full state coverage: default, hover, active, focus-visible, and disabled states.
